params.prompt:
Create an original premium motorsport TEAM MANAGEMENT GAME user interface screenshot called FORMULA OPERATIONS, Paddock Hybrid — Live Operations. This is an actual flat 2D application screen, not a monitor photograph, not a wireframe, not a poster. Deep navy-black ink environment, a few connected subtly layered dark surfaces, warm amber only for selected or actionable state, small turquoise team identity accents. Refined condensed display type for race and position numbers, comfortably readable mixed-case UI text for decisions, tabular data numerals. Design a believable shipped commercial strategy game with strong focal hierarchy and controlled breathing room. Original design: do not copy any existing game's exact layout, branding or proprietary graphics. No F1 logos, no team logos, no photographic artwork, no decorative car render.

Supported UI capabilities ONLY: lap and flag, race playback Play/Pause, 1x 2x 4x 8x, Next Strategic Event, Auto Pause; a complete scrollable 22-car timing list with position, abbreviation, gap, last lap, tyre and stops; a stylized clear circuit centreline with colored live car dots; two own cars of the SAME team, NOR and PIA, each with position, compound, wear and issue state; selected-car tyre compound, wear percentage, age laps and temperature; all five pace commands Conserve / Light / Standard / Push / Attack; fuel modes Lean / Balanced / Rich with actual kg and projected at-flag kg; energy battery percentage and Recharge / Balanced / Boost; Overtake Mode eligibility and Active Aero AUTOMATIC status; choose Soft / Medium / Hard / Intermediate / Wet for the next stop; BOX, Update and Cancel; short recent race events, current rain intensity, track water PERCENTAGE, air/track Celsius temperatures, secondary forecast/details/history. Never invent capabilities, exact tyre life predictions, pit-window forecasting, sector controls, radio, wind, sector telemetry, speedometer, sector heatmaps, extra charts or recommended strategy AI.

The visual order is race state, our two cars, strategic urgency, available decisions, secondary context. Compose this hierarchy explicitly; not everything is equally important. Avoid tiny all-caps labels everywhere. Reduce rectangle outlines and nested boxes drastically; define sections through typography, spacing, alignment and gentle surface changes. Warnings must use compact icon + readable text with acknowledgement/since-lap and More, not giant red boxed alarm bars. Track is a meaningful central visual anchor, not a small widget. Timing is a legible sports classification, not a spreadsheet. Tyres are a strong strategic focal group; Pace and Energy feel like game decisions with comfortable controls, not six identical thin engineering strips. Pit is anchored and obvious but proportionate when inactive. Secondary information may scroll internally or disclose. Primary choices remain easy to reach. No page-scroll dependence for repeated decisions. No micro-fonts, no 24px control strips. No SaaS, banking, trading dashboard, generic admin grid, neon cyberpunk, holograms, spaceship HUD, casino styling, excessive gradients or randomly gigantic whitespace.
STUDY A — PREMIUM LAPTOP. Render a 16:9 composition designed for 1366×768 / 1536×864, as though UI font sizes are approximately 14–16px at laptop size, primary controls 36–40px high. Do not shrink a Full HD screen. Slim united race header: Japanese Grand Prix, Lap 38 / 58, green flag and concise wet conditions. Left timing is narrow but readable with a strong position and driver hierarchy, no heavy cell grid. The centre circuit gets clear visual authority, elegantly lit line art without fake scenery. Above or beside the selected strategy, both own cars are easy to compare at a glance: NOR P14 Medium 79%, PIA P15 Medium 86%. Selected NOR strategy features a distinct tyre focal moment, then clearly spaced pace/energy/fuel decisions; small automatic-assist status; an anchored pit compound picker and amber BOX. Use compact secondary detail disclosure or a bounded internal context region to protect readability. Recent events stay subdued. Show a normal manageable race with one modest tyre-risk warning, Pit inactive. It should feel calm, tactical and confident. Full screen visible, no device frame, no artwork outside UI.
